description: A `derived=` machine projects `.Red` but not `.Yellow` or `.Green` of the source enum. Per §51.9 every source variant must be mapped, so E-ENGINE-018 fires (§34: Error) — once per unprojected variant.
rationale: §51.9 — a projection must be TOTAL over the source enum: every source variant needs a rule, or the projected variable has no defined value while the source sits in the uncovered variant. This is the projection-surface form of the exhaustiveness guarantee `<match>`/`<engine>` enforce structurally — a partial projection is a hole that only appears once the source reaches the missing state.
